Problem Statement:
Given a sentence, find and print the longest word in it. If multiple words are the longest, print the first one. 
Input Description:
A single line string S (a sentence). 
Output Description:
Print the longest word in the sentence. 
Sample Input:
I love programming 
Sample Output:
programming
